create_Flatten: create a Flatten layer that flattens a contiguous range of dimensions into a single tensor dimension
create_Flatten_with_dims: create a Flatten layer with custom start_dim and end_dim to flatten specific tensor dimensions
create_Unflatten: create an Unflatten layer that expands a single tensor dimension back into multiple dimensions
create_Unflatten_with_torch_size: create an Unflatten layer using torch.Size to reshape a dimension into a specified tuple of sizes
create_Unflatten_with_namedshape: create a named Unflatten layer that assigns dimension names during tensor reshaping
